theorems.name: Submission.deGiorgiSobInd_mul_lipschitz_fderiv_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (ζ u : Rn N → ℝ) (K L : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith K ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → (∀ y, 0 ≤ ζ y) → LipschitzWith L u → (∀ y, 0 ≤ u y ∧ u y ≤ 1) → (∃ K' : ℝ≥0, LipschitzWith K' (fun y ↦ ζ y * u y)) ∧ HasCompactSupport (fun y ↦ ζ y * u y) ∧ ∫ y, ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y ↦ ζ y * u y) y‖ ≤ (∫ y, ζ y * ‖fderiv ℝ u y‖) + ∫ y, u y * ‖fderiv ℝ ζ y‖
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
